This is where sovereign commerce [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/full-infrastructure-guide-cloudflare-r2-digital-product-storage-6|infrastructure]] comes in, providing a solution that doesn't rely on third-party platforms. With the right tools, you can build a digital store that processes payments and delivers products without depending on Stripe or PayPal.

content.title: Setting Up a NOWPayments Digital Store: The Full Guide

content.text: Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

Sovereign commerce infrastructure is designed to be independent of traditional payment platforms. By using GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, and Supabase or Google Sheets for order storage, you can create a fully functional digital store without relying on Stripe or PayPal. This approach gives you complete control over your store and ensures that you can process payments and deliver products without interruptions.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before deploying your digital store, you need to have a clear understanding of your products, target audience, and payment processing requirements. You'll also need to set up a NOWPayments account, which will enable you to accept cryptocurrency payments. Additionally, you'll need to choose a hosting platform, such as GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, and set up a domain name. With these components in place, you can begin building your digital store.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

To set up your payment and delivery pipeline, you'll need to integrate NOWPayments with your digital store. This involves generating an API key, configuring your payment settings, and setting up a webhook to notify your store when a payment is received. You'll also need to configure your product delivery system, which can be done using Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. With these components in place, you can start accepting payments and delivering products to your customers.
Build a digital store that doesn't rely on Stripe or PayPal.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once you've set up your digital store and payment pipeline, you can go live and start processing transactions. This involves testing your store to ensure that everything is working as expected, and then promoting your store to your target audience. When you receive your first payment, you can verify that the payment has been processed correctly and that the product has been delivered to the customer. With your store up and running, you can start generating revenue and growing your business.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

As your digital store grows, you may need to scale your infrastructure to handle increased traffic and sales. This can be done by upgrading your hosting plan, adding more storage to your order database, and optimizing your payment processing pipeline. You can also use analytics tools to monitor your store's performance and identify areas for improvement. With a scalable infrastructure in place, you can continue to grow your business and expand your customer base.
How do I receive crypto payments for my digital products?

USDT is the most practical starting point for digital product sales because it eliminates price volatility from the equation. Your buyer pays in USDT and you receive USDT — one dollar in equals one dollar received, minus the Tron network fee of under $0.10 per transaction and the NOWPayments fee of 0.5%. You do not need to manage exchange rate risk or time your conversions around market movements. When you are ready to convert to local currency, you use a P2P exchange — Binance P2P operates in most countries where conventional payment platforms are unavailable and supports competitive local currency rates.
Process payments and deliver products with ease.

Creators exploring NOWPayments and crypto payment infrastructure for digital products often have a practical conversion question: how do you actually get the funds into local currency efficiently? The answer is USDT on Tron received through NOWPayments into your self-custody wallet, then converted through P2P exchanges at near-market rates. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 deploys the complete payment verification and delivery infrastructure under your accounts in 48 hours. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 covers the full setup process in detail. See both at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

To deploy a sovereign digital store, follow these steps: set up a NOWPayments account, choose a hosting platform, configure your payment settings, set up a webhook, configure your product delivery system, test your store, and go live. With these steps complete, you can start processing payments and delivering products to your customers. Additionally, make sure to monitor your store's performance and scale your infrastructure as needed to ensure continued growth and success.
